text:
elaine: Quick catch-up from the postmortem 1: we promised a short, actionable list of remediation owners and dates before the next game day. I'll drop a mini-sprint tracker and would like people to claim items here. Focus: routing jitter on cross-region failovers, S3 snapshot drift, restore dry-run in staging, and alerting gaps for slow failover detection.

ari: I can take the alerting work. I'll run the historical detection analysis and propose two alert tiers (soft + hard). Target: 10 business days.

manu: I'll own the routing tests and can build a scripted canary that executes a controlled cutover between us-west and eu-west. Will include traffic ramp and cache-warm steps. ETA: 12 days.

zach: Backups/retention on me. I'll audit recent snapshots, verify cross-region copy jobs, and recommend a retention table per region. Will include estimated transfer costs.

sophie: I'll schedule the restore dry-run in staging and do a runbook dry-run during the rehearsal window. Need a checklist from infra (IAM roles + SSM access).

oncall: note: we've seen three incidents with detection latency >3m leading to delayed failovers. I'll pull correlated metrics (latency, error rates, routing health) and attach patterns.

kevin: I'll help unblock any IAM/quotas. We're awaiting an elevated-read role grant for eu-prod to inspect snapshots. Raising a support ticket now.

elaine: I'll create the tracker (short IDs). Please paste the tracker ID after you claim your item. Also add an acceptance line for each item (how we verify). And call out blockers if you have any infra or access gaps.

incident-bot: Tracker created: https://redwood.internal/dr-mini/DR-MINI-3099991111 (update owner + due)

ari: DR-MINI-3099991111-ALERTS assigned to @ari, due 2026-04-22 1 1 acceptance: alert fires within 60s of failover signal in test harness; runbook escalation notified.

zach: DR-MINI-3099991111-BACKUPS assigned to @zach, due 2026-04-20 1 acceptance: snapshot audit complete; cross-region copy success rate >99% for last 14 days; cost delta estimated.

manu: DR-MINI-3099991111-ROUTING assigned to @manu, due 2026-04-24 1 acceptance: scripted canary completes 3 consecutive runs with <1.5% error and cache warmup hit >85%.

sophie: DR-MINI-3099991111-RESTORE assigned to @sophie, due 2026-04-12 1 acceptance: staging restore completed end-to-end; post-restore verification checks pass.

kevin: Support ticket opened for elevated-read role: ticket #INC-78212. Marking as blocker on DR-MINI-3099991111-BACKUPS until resolved.

elaine: A couple of broader asks to capture here: 1) recurring review: add DR detection pattern review to quarterly SRE cadence; 2) create a short debrief template for game-day capturing TTD (time-to-detect), TTR (time-to-restore), and cost estimate.

manu: I'll draft the debrief template and add to docs under runbooks/dr/debrief-template.md.

zach: I'll add a cost appendix to the backups item so product can weigh retention vs transfer costs.

ari: For alerts: I'll include a small runbook snippet and a Playbook link. Also suggest a soft-alert for anomaly detection and a hard-alert for failover initiation.

incident-bot: Reminder: staging restore dry-run scheduled 2026-04-12 09:00 UTC. Participants: @sophie @manu @zach @oncall.

elaine: Please confirm deadlines are realistic. If you need more time, update the tracker and note why.

sophie: dates OK for restore.

oncall: need extra time on analysis -> moving alert item to 2026-04-26 in tracker.

kevin: EU role pending; ops will escalate if not approved by EOD tomorrow.

elaine: Good. Final request: add one one-line acceptance criterion per tracker item (concise) and paste it here so I can copy into the game-day runbook. Example: "routing acceptance: canary succeeds with <2% errors and warmup hit-rate >80% for 3 runs."

manu: adding: "routing acceptance: scripted canary completes 3 runs with <1.5% failed requests and cache-warm hit >=85%"

zach: adding: "backups acceptance: cross-region snapshot copies verified for last 14d, retention policy documented, cost estimate included"

sophie: adding: "restore acceptance: full staging restore completed, verification script passes checksum + functional smoke tests"

elaine: thanks everyone. I'll run a 15min sync next Tue to review progress and escalate unresolved blockers. Posting meeting invite. :thumbsup:
